traits.label: Description
traits.text: Parasitic on underground pupae and larvae of various insects, particularly caterpillars. When the fungus matures, it bursts forth from the host body.

traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Known for its striking appearance and its parasitic lifestyle on insects. It's one of the few species within the genus Cordyceps that can be cultivated, and it's often used as a substitute for the more famous Ophiocordyceps sinensis, the caterpillar fungus of Tibetan Plateau fame.
